recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Henrys Behind Florida's Founding", "body": "Juan Ayala walked the panel through research for his upcoming episode on the founding of Florida. He pointed to Henrys such as Plant, Flagler and Sanford, and argued that Plant and Flagler respected one another's territory while building railroads and hotels. Juan also described Hamilton Disston, who bought millions of acres and, in Juan's telling, kept the state out of bankruptcy. Gabe reported that he traced zip codes linking Cleveland, where Rockefeller was based, with Palm Beach, where Flagler worked. One of the hosts noted that Flagler echoed the word flagellate, and Juan said Homie Romy tied Plant to planting a flag."}, {"title": "Gators and the Strange Everglades", "body": "Juan described the Everglades as psychedelic and told of being stalked by alligators on a newly opened lake. He also read an 1821 remark attributed to John Randolph, who told Congress that no man would move to Florida, not from hell itself. Mario linked alligators to the bottom of the Fool card in the Crowley deck, as energy rising from the depths of chaos, and praised the symbolism of the gator roll. One of the hosts connected gators to the crocodile headed Ammit in a Moon Knight decode and to the ankle and sandal."}, {"title": "Hierophant, Tarot, and Spirit Boxes", "body": "Juan said he drew the Hierophant as his soul card from a YouTube tarot reading while he was up with a newborn, and Mario explained the card as a bridge between people and a higher source that reveals sacred truths. Another speaker noted that the card belongs to Taurus and that soul can be read as SOL, the sun. Later the panel debated whether recommendation algorithms worked like a Ouija board and whether clicking and swiping amounted to drawing sigils, with one speaker doubting that any intent lay behind it."}, {"title": "Gabe's Death Card Map of Florida", "body": "Gabe argued that the Florida state crest echoed the death card, matching its flowers and its smokestacked boat, and tied JFK, Scorpio and the hanged man to the state. He later displayed a treasure map he said he found in the death card, in which a pointing pony's hoof lined up with the Clearwater peninsula. Mario shared the logo of the Florida band Death as a parallel, and Gabe also proposed that the Osiris myth fit the Gulf of Mexico and its Red Tide better than it fit the Nile."}, {"title": "Koreshan Unity and Tabernacle Earth", "body": "Juan introduced the Koreshan community of Cyrus Teed, whose cosmology described living inside a concave earth, and said Teed's old house in Florida could be visited. A host read that the settlement lies in Lee County as a state historic site, and a host noted that Cyrus can mean sun and that Koreshan and Khonshu share the same consonants. Later Juan described the sixth century Christian Topography, which modeled the earth on the tabernacle, and the panel compared it with cube and sacred center ideas. Juan also announced a comic book project and floated a Tabernacle Earth design for his next merch."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The extraordinary conspiracy researcher Juan Ayala (The Juan On Juan Podcast) joins Vibe Rant for an open forum where we may talk about America's biggest phallus, Florida. But like any Wednesday, who really knows where the weave will lead us?
